text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A battle against Yaeno Muteki. Giving her 
absolute all to demonstrate the fruits of 
her efforts, Sakura Chiyono O ran to the 
finish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That was why, even from a single defeat, 
the loss stung so deeply. She had never 
realized how much she hated losing in a 
clash against her rivals."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And watching their race from the stands, 
Mejiro Ardan fired up her fighting spirit 
for one of the few decisive battlegrounds 
permitted to her... the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the Japanese Derby. It is 
the defining race for Sakura Chiyono O.
